title: 33 M.P.T.L. ch. 1 § 1 — Title; Authority
text:
§ 1. Title; Authority

This title may be cited as the “Mashantucket Pequot Tribal and Native American
Preference Law”. This title is adopted pursuant to the inherent authority of
the Mashantucket Pequot Tribal Council, the lawful governing body of the
Mashantucket Pequot Tribe, to regulate labor and employment within the
Reservation. Further, the Tribe has the inherent authority to exclude persons
from the Reservation and to place conditions on entry and continued presence on
the Reservation, and to govern conduct within the Reservation.
